year_launched.note: ANCC's NPD specialty credential (originally RN-BC in NPD) has existed for many years and was rebranded to NPD-BC in alignment with ANCC's specialty-credential naming. A specific launch year was not located on the issuing-body page during this run.

eligibility.value: Hold a current, active U.S. RN license (or legally recognized equivalent in another country); hold a bachelor's or higher degree in nursing; have practiced the equivalent of 2 years full-time as a registered nurse; have a minimum of 2,000 hours of clinical practice in nursing professional development within the last 3 years; and have completed 30 hours of continuing education in nursing professional development within the last 3 years.

exam_format.value: Computer-based at Prometric test centers, year-round 120-day testing window once approved. Competency-based, multiple-choice. 150 items total (125 scored + 25 unscored pretest), 3-hour time limit.
exam_format.note: Item count and time confirmed by ANCC's own NPD-BC credential page AND by the ANCC NPD-BC Test Content Outline PDF (effective 2025-02-26). The internal project file src/_data/certs.js currently lists 175 questions for NPD-BC — that value is stale and should be reconciled to 150 in a follow-up commit. See discrepancies below.

passing_score.value: Scaled score of 350 on a 0-500 scale
passing_score.note: ANCC uses a consistent scaled scoring model across its specialty certifications (350/500). Confirmed by secondary corroborating sources; ANCC's NPD-BC page does not republish the cut score on the public page.

fee_ana_member.note: Includes a $140 non-refundable administrative fee per ANCC.

fee_retake.note: ANCC retake fee for NPD-BC. Retake allowed no sooner than 60 days after a failed attempt; no more than 3 attempts in any 12-month period.

pass_rate_latest.value: 76% (most recently reported pass rate per 2024 ANCC certification data); 6,574 active NPD-BC credential holders
pass_rate_latest.note: Secondary aggregator (pocketprep.com) cites 2024 ANCC Certification Data: 1,316 examinees, 1,006 passed (76%). Direct PDF read recommended to upgrade confidence to high.

renewal.value: 5-year cycle. Renew by completing professional development requirements documented in the ANCC Certification Renewal Handbook (effective 2025-09-10) — specifically 75 contact hours of continuing education in nursing professional development plus one additional professional development category (academic credits, presentations, publications, preceptorship, professional service, or an evidence-based practice or research project), or by retaking and passing the current NPD-BC exam.

value.disambiguation: Nursing Professional Development Advanced - Board Certified, issued by the Competency & Credentialing Institute (CCI), targets advanced NPD practitioners and uses a separate eligibility track. NPD-BC is ANCC's specialty board certification for the NPD practitioner at the staff-development and educator level.

ANCC previously awarded the NPD specialty under the RN-BC credential label. Existing RN-BC holders in NPD retain the title until renewal; new candidates are credentialed as NPD-BC. The exam content and eligibility rules are otherwise the same NPD specialty.

Nurse Executive credentials, also ANCC, test leadership of nursing operations (budgets, staffing, governance) rather than the staff-education and learning-design focus of NPD-BC. Many candidates Google one when they mean the other.

Issued by the National League for Nursing (NLN), CNE targets academic faculty teaching pre-licensure or graduate nursing students. NPD-BC targets nurses educating practicing staff inside healthcare organizations.

recent_changes.value: The current NPD-BC Test Content Outline took effect 2025-02-26 (six domains, 125 scored items). ANCC Certification Renewal Requirements handbook effective 2025-09-10 governs the current renewal cycle.

credential_holders.note: Pocket Prep cites 2024 ANCC Certification Data showing 6,574 active NPD-BC credential holders.

pass_rate_history.note: Pocket Prep cites 2024 ANCC Certification Data. Direct read of the ANCC PDF recommended.

discrepancies.resolution: Use 150 - both ANCC primary sources agree. The certs.js value of 175 is stale (likely template carryover from a different ANCC credential) and should be corrected to 150 in a follow-up commit. This rendered page will display 150 to match ANCC.

Use 3 hours per ANCC's NPD-BC credential page. The 3.5-hour figure appears to come from generic ANCC-exam aggregator templates and is not consistent with the NPD-BC page or the Test Content Outline PDF.
